info.name: ECommerce - Requirement 3 (v3)
info.description:
Third requirement API. Base path /api/v3 (same contract as v1 and v2, with an optimized catalog and a performance lab).
Product list and detail return X-Cache, X-DB-Queries, X-Response-Time-Ms and X-Data-Source headers and support ETag with If-None-Match.
Run a Login request first with admin@example.com. The folder "Requirement 3 - Performance lab" is administrator only.

item.name: Requirement 2 - Inventory checks
item.description: Run these in order after logging in as admin. They prove the communication with the Node.js inventory service: stock is stored there, a failed reservation rejects the order with 409, a cancelled order releases the stock, and stopping the inventory service makes order requests return 503.

request.description: Admin only. The stock value is sent to the inventory service, not saved in the Laravel database.
The stock is read from the inventory service.
The reservation is refused, no order is created and the stock is unchanged.
Reserves the last unit atomically.
Nothing is left, so the second order is rejected.
Calls ReleaseStock with the stored reservation id.
Confirms the released unit is available again.
